text: The three most harmful addictions are heroin, carbohydrates, and a monthly salary.
text_zh: 三种最有害的成瘾是海洛因、碳水化合物和月薪。

text: My only measure of success is how much time you have to kill.
text_zh: 我衡量成功的唯一标准是你有多少时间可以消磨。

text: I wonder if a lion (or a cannibal) would pay a high premium for freerange humans.
text_zh: 我想知道狮子（或食人族）是否会为散养人类支付高价。

text: If you need to listen to music while walking, don't walk; and please don't listen to music.
text_zh: 如果你走路时需要听音乐，那就别走路；也请别听音乐。

text: Men destroy each other during war; themselves during peacetime.
text_zh: 男人在战争中摧毁彼此；在和平时期摧毁自己。

text: Sports feminize men and masculinize women.
text_zh: 体育运动让男人女性化，让女人男性化。

text: Technology can degrade (and endanger) every aspect of a sucker's life while convincing him that it is becoming more "efficient."
text_zh: 技术可以降低（并危及）傻瓜生活的方方面面，同时让他相信这变得更高效"了。"

text: The difference between technology and slavery is that slaves are fully aware that they are not free.
text_zh: 技术与奴隶制的区别在于，奴隶完全知道自己不自由。

text: You have a real life if and only if you do not compete with anyone in any of your pursuits.
text_zh: 当且仅当你在任何追求中都不与任何人竞争时，你才拥有真正的生活。

text: With terminal disease, nature lets you die with abbreviated suffering; medicine lets you suffer with prolonged dying.
text_zh: 对于绝症，自然让你在短暂痛苦中死去；医学让你在延长的死亡中受苦。

text: We are satisfied with natural (or old) objects like vistas or classical paintings but insatiable with technologies, amplifying small improvements in versions, obsessed about 2.0, caught in a mental treadmill.
text_zh: 我们对自然（或古老）的事物如风景或古典绘画感到满足，但对技术永不满足，放大版本中的微小改进，痴迷于2.0，陷入精神跑步机。

text: Only in recent history has "working hard" signaled pride rather than shame for lack of talent, finesse, and, mostly, sprezzatura.
text_zh: 只有在近代历史中，努力工作"才象征着骄傲，而不是因缺乏天赋、技巧，主要是优雅而感到羞耻。"

text: Their idea of the sabbatical is to work six days and rest for one; my idea of the sabbatical is to work for (part of) a day and rest for six.
text_zh: 他们的安息日理念是工作六天休息一天；我的安息日理念是工作（部分）一天休息六天。

text: What they call "play" (gym, travel, sports) looks like work; the harder they try, the more captive they are.
text_zh: 他们所谓的娱乐"（健身房、旅行、运动）看起来像工作；他们越努力，就越被束缚。"

text: Most modern efficiencies are deferred punishment.
text_zh: 大多数现代效率都是延迟的惩罚。

text: We are hunters; we are only truly alive in those moments when we improvise; no schedule, just small surprises and stimuli from the environment.
text_zh: 我们是猎人；只有在即兴发挥的时刻我们才真正活着；没有时间表，只有来自环境的小惊喜和刺激。

text: For everything, use boredom in place of a clock, as a biological wristwatch, though under constraints of politeness.
text_zh: 对于一切，用无聊代替时钟，作为生物手表，尽管受到礼貌的约束。

text: Decomposition, for most, starts when they leave the free, social, and uncorrupted college life for the solitary confinement of professions and nuclear families.
text_zh: 对大多数人来说，腐朽始于他们离开自由、社交和纯洁的大学生活，进入职业和核心家庭的孤独禁闭。

text: For a classicist, a competitive athlete is painful to look at; trying hard to become an animal rather than a man, he will never be as fast as a cheetah or as strong as an ox.
text_zh: 对古典主义者来说，竞技运动员看起来很痛苦；努力成为动物而不是人，他永远不会像猎豹那样快或像牛那样强壮。

text: Skills that transfer: street fights, off-path hiking, seduction, broad erudition. Skills that don't: school, games, sports, laboratory—what's reduced and organized.
text_zh: 可转移的技能：街头打斗、越野徒步、诱惑、广博学识。不可转移的技能：学校、游戏、运动、实验室——被简化和组织的东西。

text: You exist in full if and only if your conversation (or writings) cannot be easily reconstructed with clips from other conversations.
text_zh: 当且仅当你的对话（或写作）不能轻易用其他对话的片段重构时，你才完整存在。

text: The English have random Mediterranean weather; but they go to Spain because their free hours aren't free.
text_zh: 英国人有随机的地中海天气；但他们去西班牙是因为他们的自由时间并不自由。

text: For most, work and what comes with it have the eroding effect of chronic injury.
text_zh: 对大多数人来说，工作及其附带的东西具有慢性伤害的侵蚀作用。

text: Technology is at its best when it is invisible.
text_zh: 技术在不可见时最好。

text: The difference between true life and modern life equals the one between a conversation and bilateral recitations.
text_zh: 真实生活与现代生活的区别等同于对话与双边背诵的区别。

text: When I look at people on treadmills I wonder how alpha lions, the strongest, expend the least amount of energy, sleeping twenty hours a day; others hunt for them.
text_zh: 当我看到跑步机上的人时，我想知道最强壮的雄狮如何消耗最少的能量，每天睡二十小时；其他狮子为它们狩猎。

text: Every social association that is not face-to-face is injurious to your health.
text_zh: 每一种非面对面的社交联系都对你的健康有害。
